headline: Sales and earnings rise from last year
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 389.2B, up 31.4% y/y and 2.5% q/q, and net income was KRW 65.0B, up 37.7% y/y.
summary_long: Shard data show revenue of KRW 389.2B against KRW 296.1B a year ago and KRW 379.9B last quarter. Net income of KRW 65.0B compares with KRW 47.2B a year ago, and EPS was KRW 886 against KRW 643. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. A search for reported Q3 2026 results found only broker estimates, so every figure here is Yahoo shard data, unconfirmed against the company's release. Shard operating income is not used because it duplicates other line items.
